b. HVAC System. Manufacturer shall include ENERGY STAR certified, msart
  access, ductless, multi zone heating and cooling systems as manufactured by
  Mitsubishi Electric or an approved equal. The system shall be sized and zoned
  according to local code and meet all other energy efficiency standards required.
  Individually controlled wall mount units are to be provided in each living room and
  each bedroom. Brand and model numbers of proposed equipment shall be
  submitted with the proposal.
c. Appliances. All appliances must meet accessibility standards and be ENERGY
  STAR certified where available. Brand and model numbers of proposed
  equipment shall be submitted with the proposal and costs shall be included within
  the overall proposed value. Note; all appliance shall be electrically operated no
  gas appliances are to be utilized

  List of Appliances per Unit Type per below summary:

  (4) Studio Units (including 2 ADA units)
  • Single Door 24” wide Fridge / Freezer
  • 18” wide compact dishwasher
  • 12” wide, two element induction cook top
  • 1.4 cu ft, 24” wide, over the range microwave w/ extraction
  • Single basin kitchen sink

  (1) Property Manager Unit (only if included in modular scope)
  • Single Door 24” wide Fridge / Freezer
  • Standard dishwasher
  • 24” wide electric oven w/ induction cook top (4 elements)
  • 1.4 cu ft, 24” wide, over the range microwave w/ extraction
  • Single basin kitchen sink

  (8) One Bedroom Units
  • Single Door 24” wide Fridge / Freezer
  • Standard dishwasher
  • 24” wide electric oven w/ induction cook top (4 elements)
  • 1.4 cu ft, 24” wide, over the range microwave w/ extraction
  • Single basin kitchen sink

  (10) Two bedroom Unit
  • Double Door 32” wide Fridge / Freezer
  • 24” standard width dishwasher
  • 30” wide electric oven w/ induction cook top (4 elements)
  • 2.1 cu ft, 30” wide over the range microwave w/ extraction
